beta.gross-entry-cap: Known gross plus actual committed remaining entry budgets plus proposed new commitment <=4*joint equity; no held reduction.
beta.stress-entry-cap: Same gross cap plus completed20-day max downside*gross + confirmed stop/fee risk <=.20*joint equity.
beta.state-exposure: Both causal prior20day BTC directions negative -> new-risk cap2 else4; sameBTC not two independent signals.
beta.risk-capacity: When two separately sourced, known feasible preflights <=15sec old compete for gross-cap4 capacity, lower planned stop+roundtrip fee loss per notional wins; tie spot. Actual separate funds; no transfer or eviction of held/committed risk. No competitor means ordinary gross cap.

alpha_gate.cost_net_effect: positive in both chronologically fixed halves of actually qualified applicability, control prior20day momentum/RMS and simple reduced sizing; previously seen histories all development
alpha_gate.historical_vintage: Never qualify past availability from a current download or caller boolean. New-receipt evidence can only enter later observations.
alpha_gate.zero_action: Support pending; do not change starts or synthesize checkpoint.

beta_screen.selector: Earliest quarter containing actual neutral-funded Coin new campaign entry in each2020-21/2022+era. Entry timestamps only, never profit/risk outcomes. Original schedule subset; independent cold wallets. Zero intervention remains pending; no date extension or forged checkpoint.
beta_screen.candidate_selection: All four candidates, sequential. Reuse same-baseline/uniform results and inputs. No account if causal baseline proposal census shows0 new-risk effect.
beta_screen.control: Uniform .75 genuine NEW BUY sizing in both separately financed accounts, once; no curve scaling.
beta_screen.gate: Each window audited/archived/settled; >=1 independent commitment changed each window; net wealth>=baseline and observed synchronized joint MDD<=baseline+.01 OR observed joint MDD<=baseline*.8 and wealth>=baseline*.95; outperform uniform risk/wealth tradeoff. Window results cannot adopt original full-window default.
beta_screen.coupled_clock: Two separate offline workers, immutable original venue/cost engines, unmodified production finite run. Coordinator advances both to each causal virtual API tick, obtains actual independently financed wallet/protection/ownership/commitment state. One Coin worker only, UID12000 unchanged through strictly serial cases. Coordinator timing is a research execution bridge, not canonical old-account equality/native proof.
beta_screen.all_fails: Retain simplest accepted independent-budget baseline; next alpha family/new evidence rather than threshold search.

budget.same_day_existing_receipts: Reuse option/OI/ETF original bytes, no duplicate requests or manufactured independent dates.
